# gputypes

> WebGPU types for Go: the enums, flags, structs and constants of the W3C WebGPU API, such as texture formats,
> buffer and texture usages, features, limits, bind group and pipeline descriptors, vertex formats, downlevel
> capabilities and ray tracing descriptors, with format helpers. Every module of the GoGPU ecosystem shares these
> types, so values pass between them without conversion. The values are gputypes' own, as in Rust's wgpu-types,
> not the numbers of the C `webgpu.h` header; code that crosses into C converts by name. Zero dependencies,
> zero CGO, Go 1.25+. Pre-1.0: the API may change before v1.0.

- [GoGPU](https://github.com/gogpu): all modules of the GoGPU ecosystem
